items.rationale: The fixed unit is covered for lightning overvoltage under §§2.3.3 and 4.2.3 and is outside the five-metre exclusion in §2.3.10(c). Allow €1,650 gross for one equivalent floor-console split unit under §7.1.9, excluding separately billed fitting and freight.

Section 2.3.10(c) excludes the unit because it sits within five metres of the hob and no endorsement applies. If covered, one comparable wall-mounted split unit would be estimated at €1,250 gross before separately billed fitting and freight.
Section 7.1.9(c) expressly covers labour to fit, connect and commission the covered replacement. Allow €650 gross for one installation.
Under §7.1.11, installation follows the principal item, which is excluded under §2.3.10(c). If covered, one standard wall-unit installation would be estimated at €550 gross.
Section 7.1.9(b) covers the equivalent mounting stand because the original was scorched and could not be reused. Allow €180 gross for one stand, with fitting priced separately.

Sections 7.1.11–7.1.12 allow only the covered unit’s share of ordinary freight. With no weight or volume basis supplied, apportion an estimated €120 gross by unit value: €120 × 1,650 ÷ (1,650 + 1,250) ≈ €68.
